Who is Powerplex?

Unnamed father † Jessica Duvall † (sister) Becky Duvall † (wife; accidental victim) Jack Duvall † (son; accidental victim) Gretchen Duvall † (niece)

Omni-Man (indirectly) Shapesmith Atom Eve Guardians of the Globe Cecil Stedman Global Defense Agency Brit Movincihawk Kid Omni-Man Angstrom Levy (indirectly)

Scott Duvall (also known as Powerplex) is a recurring antagonist in He is a delusional and emotionally unstable scientist, who irrationally desires revenge on Invincible for his unintended role in the deaths of his sister and niece as well as the self-inflicted deaths of his wife and son.

Scott is a Caucasian man with blond hair and green eyes. He has a slim and muscular build.
